resources.string: Lyrify adds synced lyrics for the songs on your phone to Samsung Music. Two switches to turn on:
Lets Lyrify see what Samsung Music is playing and what comes next in the queue. Your notifications are not read.
Lets Lyrify find your songs and save a .lrc lyrics file next to each one. It never changes, moves or deletes your music.
Android restricts this for apps installed outside a store. In App info tap ⋮ (top right) › Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Settings › Battery › Background usage limits › Never sleeping apps › add Lyrify.
Not a song file Lyrify can match
Lyrify is not connected yet. If this lasts, switch its notification access off and on.
Plain lyrics only (waiting for AI timing)
Only synced for another version (e.g. live)
No artist in the song\'s tags
AI lyrics added (heard in the song)
Queue: %1$d of %2$d checked, paused, LRCLIB busy
Lyrify can\'t read its song list right now. If your phone is low on space, free some up.
Play something in Samsung Music. Lyrify adds lyrics for it and the rest of the queue.
Lyrify deletes the .lrc file it added for this song and will not add lyrics for it again.
Lyrics removed. Samsung Music may keep showing them until it restarts.
This lyrics file was changed outside Lyrify, so it was left alone.
The lyrics file could not be removed.
Already gone; Lyrify won\'t add lyrics for this song again.
Changed outside Lyrify, remove it with a file manager
Lyrify found lyrics that may fit, but isn\'t sure. Tap to pick the right ones.
Lyrify found lyrics that may belong to these songs, but isn\'t sure. Pick the right ones, or tell Lyrify none of them fit.
Couldn\'t load the lyrics. Try again in a moment.
Only songs about as long as yours are shown, so the lyrics stay in time.
Nothing found with the same length as your song.
LRCLIB didn\'t answer. Try again in a moment.
Picked. Lyrify times these lyrics overnight while your phone charges.
Picked. These lyrics need timing first: turn on AI lyrics to have them timed.
Picked, but these lyrics have no timing, and this phone can\'t time them.
Got it. Lyrify won\'t suggest lyrics for this song again.
This song already has a lyrics file, so it was left as it is.
Those lyrics aren\'t on LRCLIB any more, or no longer fit this song.
This song was already sorted out.
The lyrics couldn\'t be saved. Lyrify tries this song again later.
Add AI lyrics while your phone is plugged in
For songs LRCLIB has no synced lyrics for, Lyrify can listen to the song and write the lyrics itself, right on your phone. Nothing about your songs leaves your phone.
AI lyrics aren\'t available on this phone.
AI lyrics need a newer software version on your phone.
Runs on your phone\'s AI chip (%1$s).
Runs on your phone\'s AI chip (%1$s). Not tested on this chip yet.

AI models: waiting for Wi-Fi to download (%1$s of %2$s so far)
Not enough free space for the AI models: they need about %1$s free. Free up space on your phone and the download goes on by itself.
The AI models did not download correctly. Try again.
This frees %1$s and turns AI lyrics off. Lyrics already added stay.
AI lyrics start once the models are downloaded.

resources.string: Your phone did not let Lyrify start in the background. It tries again later; the tip below helps.
Paused for today: your phone allows about 6 hours of this a day. Opening Lyrify gives it more time.
The AI couldn\'t start on this phone; it\'s been paused. It tries again with the next version of Lyrify, or once you delete the models and download them again.
Paused: the AI stopped unexpectedly several times in a row. It starts again with the next version of Lyrify.

resources.string: Runs only while your phone is plugged in, also when it has stopped charging to protect the battery. A song takes under a minute.
So your phone lets it start at night, set Lyrify\'s battery use to Unrestricted in App info › Battery.
